description: Etat du trafic en temps réel is a dataset listed in DataHub Métropole de Bordeaux open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Bordeaux Métropole. Dictionnaire Public Bordeaux Métropole a équipé une partie de ses tronçons de voiries de capteurs permettant de mesurer l'encombrement de la chaussée en temps réel. La couche regroupe les données issues de ces capteurs, ainsi que les données provenant de la DIRA (Direction Interdépartementale des Routes d'Atlantique) pour la rocade. Coverage: Bordeaux Métropole. The portal files it under Transports/mobilité. Its keywords are temps réel, tronçons, circulation, voirie, voies, filaire. The portal shows 687 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-datahub-bordeaux-metropole-fr-portal.
